versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Sprint Planner skill.
- Enables rapid agile sprint planning from any backlog—outputs a full sprint plan, goal, and key templates.
- Features automated capacity math, RICE-based prioritization, built-in buffer rule, and measurable sprint goal.
- Includes output templates for daily standups, retros, and clear “definition of done” checklists.
- Highlights anti-patterns and best practices to improve delivery consistency.
